svg.aria-label: OpenSlop, the free open-source AI video creator
svg.title: OpenSlop, the free open-source AI video creator
svg.desc: Four ideas typed into the OpenSlop composer, an anime episode, a product launch with the user's own avatars, a live-action thriller and a documentary. For each, Sloppy, the copilot, thinks, replies, and builds a storyboard of image, video, speech, music and sound elements on the canvas.
